title: En passant
summary: A special pawn capture right after an enemy pawn jumps two squares.

steps.md: **En passant** means "in passing". A pawn that jumps two squares right **next to** your pawn can be captured as if it moved one.
Black just jumped d7 to d5. Your pawn may capture it by moving to d6.

steps.prompt: Black just jumped c7 to c5. Capture en passant!

steps.question: When can you capture en passant?
choices: Right after the enemy pawn jumps two squares
steps.explain: Only on the very next move.
